rounds.q: On an average day, what % of Americans (15+) do housework like cleaning?
rounds.why: Women were about twice as likely as men to do housework that day: 48% vs 24%.
rounds.src: US Bureau of Labor Statistics, American Time Use Survey, Table 1 (2025 data)
rounds.fun: 36% tidy up on a typical day. That leaves a lot of dust bunnies in peace!

rounds.q: What % of US homes have a dishwasher that nobody uses?
rounds.why: About 74% of US homes have a dishwasher, so roughly 1 in 5 of them sits unused.
rounds.src: US Energy Information Administration, 2024 RECS Housing Characteristics Highlights (2024 data, preliminary)
rounds.fun: 14% of homes have a dishwasher nobody uses. Fanciest drying rack ever!

rounds.q: On days Americans do yard work, how many minutes do they spend on it?
rounds.why: That is 1.9 hours, but only 10% of Americans do any yard work on an average day.
rounds.src: US Bureau of Labor Statistics, American Time Use Survey, Table 1 (2025 data)
rounds.fun: 114 minutes is 1.9 hours of mowing and weeding. Lemonade well earned!

rounds.q: About how many loads of laundry does the average US family wash in a year?
rounds.why: An efficient washer uses about 14 gallons of water per load, a standard one uses 20.
rounds.src: ENERGY STAR (US EPA), Clothes Washers (page read Nov 2026)
rounds.fun: 300 loads a year, at 14 to 20 gallons each. The sock pile never sleeps!

rounds.q: About how many pounds of trash does the average American make in a day?
rounds.why: EPA counts 4.9 pounds each, from homes, schools and businesses. About 1.6 gets recycled or composted.
rounds.src: US Environmental Protection Agency, National Overview: Facts and Figures on Materials, Wastes and Recycling (2018 data, latest)
rounds.fun: About 5 pounds of trash a day each. No wonder the bin is always full!
